title: Operational Creditor v. Real Estate Co
text: The operational creditor filed an application under Section 9 of the IBC for initiating CIRP against the corporate debtor for non-payment of operational debt of Rs 2,50,00,000 for supply of goods. A demand notice under Section 8 of IBC was served but the corporate debtor neither paid the debt nor disputed the existence of the operational debt. Under IBC, upon satisfaction of the threshold conditions, CIRP is to be admitted. The corporate debtor raised a plea of pre-existing dispute in the invoice. The NCLT finds that the alleged dispute was not raised before issuance of the Section 8 notice and hence is a post-notice dispute not qualifying as a pre-existing dispute under IBC. CIRP is admitted. An Interim Resolution Professional is appointed. The moratorium under Section 14 of IBC applies with immediate effect.
